items.title: Earl King Interview, 1980-04-10
items.q: he spoke to Kate Mow Brown, it's in the presence of Kate Mow, and T-Bone Walker, Louis Wilson

ctx.x: What does Slim look like in concert? What do you look like when he came out? Can you describe that?

Well, pastels and gear, I mean neon, everything, he's lit up. I mean, his concept was this. If he's working with an audience, in a strange outfit, every night, which he's playing one night, he thought that. He said, Earl, the guy who comes up there with the red suit on, and the yellow shoes, and all that for the gig, he said, they will remember him. You know, they won't forget him.
